features: Engineered For Comfort: The adjustable headband and soft cushioned ear cups provide a custom fit, While its lightweight design allows for extended gaming sessions without feeling fatigued.
Powerful Driver: 50mm Driver delivers immersive, high-fidelity sound with deep bass and clear treble for an enhanced gaming experience.
Retractable Mic: Features adjustable microphone that captures clear voice transmission, while the dedicated mute button allows for instant and side easy muting.
Connectivity: Features a 3.5mm audio cord for high-quality sound transmission and a USB connection dedicated to powering the stunning 7-color RGB lighting.
Volume Roller: Easily accessible volume control roller for quick and precise sound adjustments without interrupting your gameplay.
Braided Cable: Features a 2-meter braided cable for enhanced durability and tangle-free performance, ensuring long-lasting, uninterrupted gaming sessions.
